test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'SPORTY' is written as ‘QMKMNR’ and ‘PREYS’ is written as ‘NOATM’. How will ‘CLIP’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

• 'SPORTY' is written as ‘QMKMNR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b30b7d6de64fca34190ac1ea1aaa60778d360965df65bb69b44b6d27600fb479.png] 

• ‘PREYS’ is written as ‘NOATM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9a7fc82fcb9b0f867b4dfb6dbbe17610b4a4b81121b95825b65063764e14c02.png] 

• Similarly, ‘CLIP’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dbb3b788ef2f2d067648b796ffa6c9195d1b58fc5bcfaf057af9163b6a86dd0.png] 

Hence,** 'option 3'** is the correct answer.
